svg.title: The life of a chip at a glance
svg.desc: Eight stops from design, mask making, wafer start, front end, wafer test, packaging, final test to shipment.
svg.text: The life of a chip, from idea to shipment
One wafer, eight stops (icons are illustrative, not to scale)
From wafer start to shipment, the front end plus the back end often takes three to four months or more.
